target_customer: Mobile engineering teams at large app companies (DoorDash, Square, Airbnb, Duolingo, Spotify) that pay for developer tooling
problem: Mobile apps bloat in size and slow in launch, and teams build custom tooling to track it. Emerge sells off-the-shelf size analysis, snapshot testing and performance tools.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for developer tools

founders.name: Josh Cohenzadeh
founders.background_notes: Reported to have worked with Noah Martin on app development since 2011.

technical_complexity.rationale: Binary analysis of iOS and Android builds, dead code detection from production usage and startup order files require deep platform knowledge.

defensibility.rationale: Specialist expertise in app binaries and CI integration is hard to copy quickly, though large companies can build in-house tools.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copied it; Sentry bought Emerge in May 2025 and relaunched Size Analysis inside Sentry in February 2026.

market_need_then: App size affects installs and App Store limits; a January 2021 post showed Dropbox at 269 MB with about 40 percent reducible, and large teams built custom tooling for this.

branding.domain_note: Operated at emergetools.com rather than emerge.com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Measurable-results and developer-focused messaging; open-sourced Reaper and Launch Booster.

branding.brand_signature: Public app-size teardown posts such as 7 apps that could save you 500MB
branding.community_and_virality: Blog analyses of popular app sizes were covered by outside outlets (Medium, supercarblondie).

brand_strength.rationale: Content marketing got press, but no search turned up coverage of the brand itself, and the generic name is confusable with many other Emerge companies.

outcome_analysis: Emerge started with iOS app size analysis in 2020 and expanded to snapshots, dead code removal and launch speed, winning customers such as OpenAI, Spotify, Duolingo and Square with a very small team. Sentry acquired it on May 6, 2025 for undisclosed terms and rebuilt Size Analysis in its own product. The outcome fits a niche technical product bought by a platform that wanted mobile depth.
notes: Funding unverified: aggregators (VCBacked, StartupIntros, Extruct, CB Insights) list a roughly 1.7 to 2M seed in Nov 2021 (YC, Haystack, Matrix, Liquid 2) and a roughly 7.3M Series A in Oct 2024, but no press release or second independent outlet was found, so no rounds are recorded. Founder names per YC page (Josh Cohenzadeh, Noah Martin); one aggregator listed a different name, ignored. Competition empty: search found no dated competitor coverage near 2021.
